description: This file defines a 'Home' component for a furniture shopping web application using the LightningJS framework. It includes component imports (Header, ProductCard, FloatingCartButton, CheckoutModal), manages UI state such as loading/error messages, product layout, and modal visibility, and sets up subscriptions to a centralized store (AppStore) to reflect application state. The component renders a structured template with various UI elements and handles dynamic updates based on app state.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns the initial reactive state of the component, including UI tokens, data arrays, and modal flags.

methods.name: watchers
methods.description: Defines reactive watchers for width, height, products, and checkoutOpen to perform side effects on state changes.

methods.name: subscriptions
methods.description: Sets up a subscription to AppStore to update local state based on global store changes.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes the component on startup, sets dimensions, and loads products if not already loaded.
